ai_summary: This document is a routine compliance filing by Avalon Technologies Limited, confirming that its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent (R&STA) processed no dematerialization or rematerialization requests for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. A minor red flag is the R&STA's certificate containing boilerplate language implying transaction processing, immediately followed by a clarifying note that no requests were actually received, suggesting an inconsistent use of templates.
